body.x: Wellograph(http://www.wellograph.com/) announced sapphire wellness watch 'Wellograph' at 'CES Unveiled' of the 'CES 2014', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

It is an activity tracker, a heart rate monitor and a running watch. It senses the quality of your activities to the integrated heart rate sensor. It tells how much you have moved, but more importantly, how hard you have exercised.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance.More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
